ResolveSource.description:
Origin of a resolved redirect URI.

Mirrors the upstream Go xurl labels at `config/config.go:62-72`.
The `#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]` directive produces
`"env-var"`, `"app-config"`, and `"built-in-default"` in JSON output
(the machine-readable shape consumed by `--output json`); the
human-readable text rendering uses [`ResolveSource::as_text_label`].

oneOf.description: Resolved from the per-app value stored in `~/.xurl`.

description: Response shape for `xr auth apps redirect-uri get` under `--output json`.

effective_redirect_uri.description: Effective redirect URI after applying the precedence chain.

stored_redirect_uri.description: Stored per-app redirect URI; `None` when no value is stored.
